# LIGHTSPEED receiver 046D:C547 ("USB Receiver") with a HID++ 2.0 mouse
# (PRO X Superlight) paired on index 1.
#
# Synthetic transcript: frames built from the layouts in Linux
# drivers/hid/hid-logitech-hidpp.c (short 0x10 / long 0x11 reports, 0x8F
# HID++ 1.0 error) and Solaar lib/logitech_receiver (base.py ping,
# hidpp10_constants.py NotificationFlag.WIRELESS, hidpp20.py feature calls,
# notifications.py 0x41 link notification). Replace with a real capture in
# Task 14.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads; frames shorter than their role (7 / 20 bytes) are zero-padded. The
# `out` lines after an `in` are the writes that frame causes.

# Group arrival: read the receiver's notification flags (register 0x00).
out short 10 FF 81 00 00 00 00
in  short 10 FF 81 00 00 00 00
# Wireless notifications off: set only bit 0x01 of the middle byte.
out short 10 FF 80 00 00 01 00
in  short 10 FF 80 00 00 00 00
# Ping every device index (HID++ 2.0 root fn 1, mark 0x5A).
out short 10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 02 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 03 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 04 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 05 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 06 00 1B 00 00 5A
# Indices 2..6 are empty: HID++ 1.0 error 0x08 (unknown device).
in  short 10 02 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 03 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 04 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 05 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 06 8F 00 1B 08 00
# Index 1 answers with protocol 4.2: HID++ 2.0.
in  long  11 01 00 1B 04 02 5A
# Root getFeature 0x0005 (device name and type) -> index 3.
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 05 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 03
# Root getFeature 0x0003 (firmware info, unit id) -> index 2.
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 03 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 02
# Root getFeature 0x1004 (unified battery) -> index 6.
out short 10 01 00 0B 10 04 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 06
# 0x0005 fn 0: name length 16.
out short 10 01 03 0B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 0B 10
# 0x0005 fn 1 at offset 0: "PRO X Superlight".
out short 10 01 03 1B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 1B 50 52 4F 20 58 20 53 75 70 65 72 6C 69 67 68 74
# 0x0005 fn 2: device type 3 (mouse).
out short 10 01 03 2B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 2B 03
# 0x0003 fn 0: unit id 1A2B3C4D in bytes 1..5.
out short 10 01 02 0B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 02 0B 00 1A 2B 3C 4D
# 0x1004 fn 1: 80 %, level bits "good", discharging -> registered.
out short 10 01 06 1B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 06 1B 50 04 00 00
# Battery broadcast (fn 0, software id 0): 79 %, no write.
in  long  11 01 06 00 4F 04 00 00
# Receiver 0x41: link lost on index 1 -> asleep.
in  short 10 01 41 04 40 00 00
# Receiver 0x41: link back on index 1 -> Connected grant -> one battery read.
in  short 10 01 41 04 00 00 00
out short 10 01 06 1B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 06 1B 4E 04 00 00
# Receiver 0x41: link on unknown index 2 (new pairing) -> Connected grant on
# the receiver -> ping index 2 only.
in  short 10 02 41 04 00 00 00
out short 10 02 00 1B 00 00 5A
# Resource error (device asleep): nothing registered, no retry.
in  short 10 02 8F 00 1B 09 00
